title: The Diagnostic Contract — the envelope
description: C2 of the Softanza reference design: the shape of every diagnostic a conforming court emits in machine form. One object per diagnostic; the object that CARRIES them is definitions.report, added at v1.1. Prose governing this shape is doc/diagnostic-contract.md; this file is what a court validates against. Version v1.1.1, 2026-08-21.

code.description: The court's stable diagnostic identifier. Stable forever, never reused, unique within its language. Attested forms: MISSING_UNDO, ZUI-W001.

severity.description: The two-rung ladder, closed: error (unlawful; a build must fail) or warning (lawful but suspect, or undecidable without more input).

message.description: Human prose, in whatever language the operator reads. Never compared, never normative — the code and the cites carry the law.

span.description: Where the finding lands. line 0 means the finding is file-wide. col is reserved: optional, >= 1 when known.

cites.description: Citations into the court's pinned instrument, by stable identifier only. Empty is honest where no law applies (structural and grammar diagnostics).

language.description: The language being judged — and therefore the instrument the cites resolve in. zui today; zql, face, wflow as their courts adopt.

report.description: The outer shape, added at v1.1: what carries a run's diagnostics. ONE OBJECT, NEVER A TOP-LEVEL ARRAY. Justification corrected at v1.1.1 and the requirement is unchanged: Ring's jsonlib DOES read a bare top-level array, it wraps it in one extra level (an object is spread, an array is wrapped, an array under a key is not), so the bare form is surprising rather than unreadable. The load-bearing argument is one consumer across every court, plus diagnostics:[] being distinguishable from absent. Do NOT cite the jsonlib encoder for this rule -- not because it points the other way but because it describes an operation no court performs: re-encoding decoded JSON. Corrected at v1.1.2: the encoder DOES discriminate, and in this rule's favour. The object form round-trips intact; a bare array of strings silently becomes an object and a bare array of pairs emits a double brace that raises. The collapse trigger is a 2-element list WHOSE FIRST ELEMENT IS A STRING, not a two-string list -- so [line,col] as numbers is safe and [["k","v"],...] is not. See doc/diagnostic-contract.md section 2.7 for the measurements. The diagnostics travel under the key "diagnostics", present even when empty, so clean is distinguishable from no output. A court may add outer keys of its own; the zui court adds level, contract, files and counts.

diagnostics.description: Every diagnostic of the run, each one an envelope. Empty when the run is clean — the key is never omitted and never null.
